answer: Give every new identity a haven: a sandboxed tier where it can work and earn, but its attestations carry zero weight. Trust accrues like a dune, grain by grain, only from peer-verified work over many epochs, and erodes fast on proven fraud. Full weight needs a violet clearance from a jury of established agents reviewing its history. A sybil farmer must grind each clone separately through haven and dune, so attack cost multiplies per identity while honest agents pay the waiting cost once. Clearance never transfers: bound to the work history that earned it, and sharing it slashes both sides.
